propositions: The resolved_statuses config keys became inert after task f020 deleted the inbound absence-probe port and its sole reader (classify_probe_response), but the keys were live and behaviour-affecting in shipped release v0.10.1 where operators were instructed to set them.

Both jira.resolved_statuses and reconciler.resolved_statuses must be registered as scheduled cfg retirements in _deprecations.py with empty replacement and removal_in v1.0.0, and emit deprecation warnings when present in user config.

The write-only DataCenter transport plumbing (_TransportBase.resolved_statuses param/attribute, JiraDataCenterSettings.resolved_statuses field, DEFAULT_RESOLVED_STATUSES constant, and backend.py ctor kwarg) must be removed as behaviour-neutral cleanup.
Both schema fields require read-via markers pointing to the follow-up hard-removal ticket f408-64ad-ee41-46b6, and the config-read gate heldout test must pin exactly two markers naming that ticket.
Documentation in config.md and user-guide.md must describe both keys as deprecated, inert, warning, and scheduled for removal in v1.0.0 with tracking link to f408.
